text: Understanding databases is an essential skill for anyone working with data. A database stores and organizes information so it can be easily accessed and managed. There are two main types: SQL databases, which use structured tables with rows and columns, and NoSQL databases, which are more flexible and store data differently. To retrieve information, you write queries, which are instructions that ask the database for specific data. Good data modeling helps you design tables that reflect real-world relationships and reduce duplication. Finally, indexes make searches faster by helping the database find rows quickly, though they need extra storage space.
